title: Draco
summary: Raleigh names Draco in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Draco, cast out of Thebes with help of Sphinx, whose sister the helper then married, as one report hath it. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XIII, §. V, sig. 268a
